# mdzgholi.ge — Complete Knowledge Base & Services Documentation

> mdzgholi.ge is Georgia's premier 24/7 on-demand driver and emergency roadside assistance platform, headquartered in Tbilisi.

## Company Overview

- **Name:** mdzgholi.ge
- **Website:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge
- **Phone & WhatsApp:** +995 568 83 47 07
- **Email:** info@mdzgholi.ge
- **Headquarters:** Tbilisi, Georgia (serves all city districts and nationwide routes)
- **Operating Hours:** 24/7 — 365 days a year, including all holidays and severe weather
- **Average Driver & Technician Arrival Time:** 15–20 minutes within Tbilisi
- **Languages Supported:** Georgian (ქართული), English, Russian

## Complete Services Directory

### 1. Sober Driver (ფხიზელი მძღოლი / მძღოლი გამოძახებით)
- **URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/sober-driver
- **Description:** A verified, professional sober driver arrives at your exact location (restaurant, bar, lounge, private residence, corporate event, clinic) and drives you home safely in your own vehicle. Your car stays with you overnight — no need to retrieve it the next morning or worry about parking.
- **Starting Price:** from 40 GEL within Tbilisi (exact quote fixed upfront with dispatch)
- **Availability:** 24 hours / 7 days / 365 days a year
- **Average Arrival:** 15–20 minutes across Tbilisi
- **Common Scenarios:** Celebrations with alcohol, late-night exhaustion, post-anesthesia/medical procedures, vehicle relocation without owner driving.

#### Frequently Asked Questions: Sober Driver
- **How do I book a sober driver in Tbilisi?**
  Call or WhatsApp +995 568 83 47 07. The operator dispatches the nearest active driver immediately. No app download or registration required.
- **Does the sober driver drive my car?**
  Yes. The driver arrives via escort/support vehicle, takes the wheel of your car, and parks it safely at your destination.
- **How much does a sober driver cost in Tbilisi?**
  Prices start from 40 GEL for inner-city trips. The fare is agreed upon before departure with zero hidden surge multipliers.
- **Is the service available late at night and during holidays?**
  Yes. mdzgholi.ge operates 24/7/365, including New Year's Eve, Easter, and national holidays.
- **What about driver vetting and vehicle responsibility?**
  All drivers have a minimum of 5 years of verified driving experience, pass clean-record background checks, and the company maintains full operational protocols to guarantee safety and integrity.

### 2. Personal Driver (პირადი მძღოლი)
- **URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/personal-driver
- **Description:** Dedicated chauffeur hire on a daily, weekly, or monthly contractual basis. Ideal for business executives, visiting delegations, and busy families needing consistent transportation for children to schools and activities.
- **Options:** Full-time, part-time, single-day, or multi-week arrangements.
- **Vehicle:** The chauffeur operates your personal or company automobile.
- **Languages:** Drivers fluent in Georgian, English, and Russian.

#### Frequently Asked Questions: Personal Driver
- **Can I hire a personal driver for a single day?**
  Yes. Flexible packages range from a few hours or a single day to ongoing monthly contracts.
- **Can the driver manage school commutes for children?**
  Yes. Highly vetted, reliable drivers are frequently assigned for family and school commutes.
- **Can English-speaking or Russian-speaking drivers be requested?**
  Yes. Chauffeurs fluent in English and Russian are available for international guests and partners.

---

### 3. Battery Charging & Jump Start (აკუმულატორის დატენვა და მანქანის დაქოქვა)
- **URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/battery-charging
- **Description:** Emergency mobile car battery jump starting and charging in Tbilisi. Powered by professional micro-controlled 12V digital booster jump starters with reverse polarity and overvoltage surge suppression. 100% safe for sensitive ECUs, hybrid auxiliary batteries, and modern electronic systems.
- **Services:** Booster jump start, alternator output diagnostics, parasitic draw testing, on-site new battery delivery and installation.
- **Average Arrival Time:** 15–20 minutes in all Tbilisi districts.
- **Key Terms (KA):** აკუმულატორის დატენვა, დატენვა, დამჯდარი აკუმულატორის დამუხტვა, მანქანის დაქოქვა გამოძახებით, პერემიჩკა გამოძახებით, ბუსტერით დაქოქვა.

#### Frequently Asked Questions: Battery Charging
- **Can mdzgholi.ge start a dead car battery on-site?**
  Yes. A technician arrives within 15–20 minutes with high-output digital jump starters to start the vehicle safely.
- **Does booster starting damage vehicle electronics?**
  No. Unlike crude jumper cables connected to a running donor car, digital boosters deliver filtered, stable current protected against voltage spikes.
- **What if the battery is completely failed and won't hold charge?**
  The technician conducts testing. If unrecoverable, we can deliver and install a brand-new branded battery with warranty on the spot.

### 4. Mobile Tire Change & Roadside Repair (საბურავის შეცვლა)
- **URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/tire-change
- **Description:** 24/7 mobile tire puncture repair, wheel swap, and tire inflation service anywhere in Tbilisi without towing the car to a stationary tire shop.
- **Tools:** Heavy-duty hydraulic jacks, impact wrenches, tire puncture vulcanization plugs, portable high-pressure air compressors.
- **Average Arrival Time:** 15–20 minutes.

---

### 5. Tow Truck / Evacuator (ევაკუატორი)
- **URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/evacuator
- **Description:** Rapid towing and vehicle evacuation across Tbilisi and Georgia for sedans, SUVs, low-clearance sports cars, and small commercial vans.
- **Capabilities:** Hydraulic sliding platforms, electric winches for vehicles stuck off-road or in ditches, technical dollies for wheels locked in park.
- **Passenger Seating:** 1–2 passengers can ride comfortably in the tow truck cabin.

### 6. Car Wash with Pickup & Delivery (მანქანის რეცხვა მისამართიდან)
- **URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/car-wash
- **Description:** A driver picks up your car from your office or home, takes it to a premium detailing and wash partner, and returns it spotless.
- **Packages:** Exterior express wash, full interior detailing, deep dry cleaning.

### 7. Airport Transfer & Intercity (აეროპორტის ტრანსფერი)
- **URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/airport-transfer
- **Description:** Punctual meet & greet transfers to/from Tbilisi International Airport (TBS), Kutaisi Airport (KUT), and Batumi Airport (BUS). Also provides intercity private transfers (Tbilisi–Batumi, Tbilisi–Kazbegi, Tbilisi–Kutaisi, Tbilisi–Bakuriani, Tbilisi–Gudauri).
- **Features:** Free flight delay tracking, meet & greet in arrivals with name sign, child safety seats available upon request.
